aggregate_order.rule: FR-322-AC-260, FR-322-AC-265: the six reference aggregates of a timed_model root (clock_places, resets, guards, invariants, urgencies, constraints), the constraints of every guard part and the bounds of a time_invariant list their members in declared order, the strictly ascending order of the member node's order key: the minimum (source.identity, start, end) over every region of every source_map entry of the node, compared in that order, and, when two members have one minimum triple, the place path key of a clock_place (step by step; field by name bytes, union by case bytes, tuple by index, slot by collection name bytes, then minimum, then maximum with unbounded last). No node id enters the order. A member that is not above its predecessor refuses invalid_semantic_graph, with no cause, at that member.
aggregate_order.order_key: the pair (minimum (source.identity, start, end) over all regions of all source_map entries of the member node, place path key); the path key of a node that is not a clock_place is empty

cases.subject: clock_places in ascending node-id order, which is not the declared order
two places share a start: the end orders them, the first place ending first is in order
two places share a start and the first ends after the second: the end decides, so this is out of order
a member with a second source_map entry (ordinal 1) whose region starts earlier: the key is the minimum over every entry, so the second place is out of order
places c and b share one region (2001, 2002) and are listed b before c: the path key orders them, so this is in order
the same shared region with c listed before b: the path key decides, so the second place is out of order

GD-02's duplicate of s given the region of s and listed right after it: equal region and equal path, so the order key is equal and the member is refused as out of order, before and instead of the twin's malformed-clock-place row refusal

path_key.order: a path compares step by step; a shorter path that is a prefix of a longer one is below it
path_key.field_and_union: UTF-8 bytes of the field name, or of the union case
path_key.slot: UTF-8 bytes of the collection kind, then the minimum as an integer, then the maximum as an integer with unbounded above every integer; the selector, a reference, never enters the key
path_key.note: A place with no region of its own carries the region of its model's declaration (a source_map entry has at least one region, and the selected model document is not a source artifact), so several such places share one minimum triple and the path orders them. resolved_path is not read: it is derived from the path and the document.
